item.title: Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook
item.description:
782
ABNT20 KNHC 020529
TWOAT

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
200 AM EDT Wed Sep 2 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center has issued its last advisory on
Tropical Depression Edouard, located inland over southeastern
Texas. The next advisory on Edouard will be issued by the Weather
Prediction Center at 4 am CDT.

Tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days.

$$
Forecaster Pasch

item.title: Summary for Tropical Depression Edouard (AT5/AL052026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...GUSTY WINDS AND HEAVY RAINFALL FROM TROPICAL DEPRESSION EDOUARD CONTINUES TO GRADUALLY SPREAD ACROSS SOUTHEAST TEXAS.. As of 4:00 AM CDT Wed Sep 02 the center of Edouard was located near 30.8, -95.0 with movement NNW at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1004 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

item.description: The NHC has issued its final advisory on this system. Public Advisories from the Weather Prediction Center will provide updates as long as the system remains a flood threat. Issued at 400 AM CDT Wed Sep 02 2026

item.title: Tropical Depression Edouard Forecast Discussion Number 8
item.description:
Issued at 400 AM CDT Wed Sep 02 2026 
000
WTNT45 KWNH 020841
TCDAT5
 
Tropical Depression Edouard Discussion Number   8
NWS Weather Prediction Center College Park MD   AL052026
400 AM CDT Wed Sep 02 2026
 
Rainfall forecasts for the United States can always be found at
https://www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov/qpf/qpf2.shtml
and outlooks of flash flood risks can be found at
https://www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov/qpf/excessive_rainfall_outlook_ero.php
 
For a list of rainfall observations (and wind reports) associated 
with Edouard, see the companion storm summary at WBCSCCNS5 with the 
WMO header ACUS45 KWBC or at the following link:
www.wpc.ncep.noaa.gov/discussions/nfdscc5.html. 
 
Key Messages:
 
1. Wind gusts to tropical-storm force are likely near the center of
Edouard for the next several hours.
 
2. As the depression lifts slowly to the north-northwest, heavy rain 
bands from Edouard will begin to pull north of the Upper Texas coast 
and southwest Louisiana Wednesday morning, while slowly tracking 
across east-central Texas through Thursday morning. Flash flooding 
is likely across this region, especially in urban areas. Significant 
flash flooding is possible. River flooding may also be possible.
 
 
FORECAST POSITIONS AND MAX WINDS
 
INIT  02/0900Z 30.8N  95.0W   30 KT  35 MPH
 12H  02/1800Z 31.4N  95.5W   25 KT  30 MPH...INLAND
 24H  03/0600Z 32.4N  96.1W   20 KT  25 MPH...POST-TROP/REMNT LOW
 36H  03/1800Z...DISSIPATED
 
$$
Forecaster Hurley
